text:
rachel: Quick sync: a11y audit + UX tweaks for roles matrix / invite flow. Highlights: aria announcements, SSO toggle copy, audit-log jump, persistent invite errors. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/unique/roles-console tom: Repro'd the screen-reader issue: expanding a role says only 'row expanded' and loses the role label. Suggest aria-live: 'Role: Billing Admin expanded' and pair region with aria-labelledby. anika: Mobile chevron hit target is tiny. Recommend 44x44 touch area and darker icon #0f172a. Also chip spacing feels cramped; use tokens 8/12. mohamed: Invite bulk errors need better surface. Current toast vanishes. Propose persistent 'Invite errors (2) 1 View errors' that opens a modal listing emails + copyable reasons + 'Retry failed'. Include keyboard focus flow back to the CSV input. rachel: SSO toggle copy: 'Enforce SSO' is ambiguous. Prefer 'Require Single Sign-On (SSO) to sign in' with inline 'What this means' link to docs. a11y-bot: Scan: /console/roles-matrix issues: missing aria-labelledby on expanded panels (1), focus-trap bug when panel opens (1), contrast warning on microcopy. Link: https://a11y-reports.internal/17667 tom: Quick ARIA example to pair header and announcement:

Billing Admin

...
anika: If focus moves into panel, ESC should return focus to the chevron and panel must have a visible focus ring. I'll mock frames by EOD. mohamed: Edge-case: invited users already under enforced SSO via IdP. Error copy should be 'User exists with SSO enforcement. Use SSO invite or add via SCIM.' rachel: Thanks. We'll review mocks in tomorrow's design crit. Drop any audit filter / SCIM edge-cases here before then.
